_comment: CANONICAL DEPLOYMENT MANIFEST - the single source of truth for the live deployment. Read by the frontend (src/config/cauldron.ts, perp.ts, chains.ts) AND the indexer (ponder.config.ts, src/index.ts, src/api/index.ts, start.mjs). It lives inside indexer/ because `railway up` only uploads that directory; the frontend reaches across the tree for it so neither side can be updated alone. To ship a deployment: edit THIS FILE ONLY, then redeploy both. Bump `schema` to force a clean reindex. NEVER mirror these values into hosting env vars - an env override wins silently and the two drift the moment one is changed alone.
